title: Live Hyperledger Fabric
status: LIVE FABRIC — ACHIEVED (real local network, real chaincode, real transactions)
scope: Genuinely attempt to eliminate P8's BLOCKED — ENVIRONMENT classification for live Hyperledger Fabric by standing up a real local network and connecting the project's real chaincode and Fabric Gateway client to it, wherever the environment permits.

Docker images: hyperledger/fabric-peer, fabric-orderer, fabric-ccenv, fabric-baseos, fabric-ca (all v2.5.16/v1.5.17)
Real network: 3 CA servers (ca_org1, ca_org2, ca_orderer), 2 peers (peer0.org1, peer0.org2), 1 orderer (etcdraft)

defects_found_and_fixed.description: MSYS/Git-Bash blocked Unix->Windows path translation of FABRIC_CFG_PATH for configtxgen.exe
defects_found_and_fixed.root_cause: session-wide MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 set earlier in P9.1 for an unrelated fix
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: unset MSYS_NO_PATHCONV for Fabric tooling; scoped MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL to protect only compose files' container-internal paths

defects_found_and_fixed.description: Docker Desktop race condition creating 3 containers concurrently: mkdir C:\Program Files\Git\var: Access is denied
defects_found_and_fixed.root_cause: spurious host bind-mount path generated during concurrent container creation on Windows Docker Desktop backend
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: start peer0.org1, peer0.org2, orderer sequentially instead of in one batch up -d call

defects_found_and_fixed.description: No host Unix docker.sock for peer's classic Docker-in-Docker chaincode build path
defects_found_and_fixed.root_cause: Windows Docker Desktop has no host-accessible Unix socket file, only a named pipe or WSL2-internal socket; fundamental platform incompatibility
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: switched to Fabric's officially-supported Chaincode-as-a-Service (CCaaS) deployment mode, which needs no peer-side Docker access
defects_found_and_fixed.classification: genuine environment limitation, worked around via an equally-real alternative deployment mode

defects_found_and_fixed.description: Stale generated crypto material contaminated retries after failed attempts
defects_found_and_fixed.root_cause: own cleanup passes accidentally deleted a git-tracked template script and left an orphaned ca-cert.pem with no matching private key
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: git checkout -- / git clean -fdx on fabric-samples organizations/fabric-ca/ to restore pristine state before clean retries

defects_found_and_fixed.description: fabric-chaincode-node 'start' subcommand always dials out as a client regardless of CHAINCODE_SERVER_ADDRESS
defects_found_and_fixed.root_cause: genuine CCaaS listening mode requires the separate 'server' subcommand, not 'start'

defects_found_and_fixed.description: Chaincode module export shape incompatible with fabric-shim's bootstrap discovery: 'contractClass is not a constructor'
defects_found_and_fixed.root_cause: fabric-shim requires package.json main module to export a `contracts` array; existing dist/ecotrace-lifecycle.js only had the named export used by unit tests/fake gateway server
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: added new src/index.ts exporting `contracts: [EcoTraceLifecycleContract]` alongside the existing named export; repointed package.json main/types. The tested contract class itself was not modified.
defects_found_and_fixed.regression_check: all 47 existing chaincode unit tests pass unchanged, before and after

out_of_scope_finding.root_cause: fake model predict() call is near-zero-cost; benchmark_inference rounds latency to 3 decimal places, occasionally rounding a genuinely-elapsed but sub-microsecond duration to exactly 0.000ms on a fast/idle machine
out_of_scope_finding.location: intelligence/device_ai/training/detector/benchmark.py and its test — unrelated to blockchain/Fabric
out_of_scope_finding.action_taken: documented, root-caused, NOT modified (out of P9.2's declared scope per 'no unrelated modifications'); flagged for P9.6 Performance phase or a dedicated fix
out_of_scope_finding.confirmed_not_a_p92_regression: same test passed cleanly (0 failures suite-wide) in the P9.1 junit baseline run of the same suite
